tools.name: dropslop_detect
tools.description: Score one or more texts with DropSlop's calibrated Dual-Head AI Detector (two trained heads: ModernBERT and Qwen-0.5B token surprisal, plus de-biased stylometrics). Returns p_ai (0.0-1.0), band (CLEAN, WARM, HOT), and per-head scores.

tools.name: dropslop_xray
tools.description: Run a full paragraph-by-paragraph and sentence-by-sentence Slop X-Ray on a document. Identifies exact AI tell spans (throat-clearing openers, contrastive pivots, lexical cliches, em-dash overuse), sentence cadence flatness (CV), and bounded surgical edit suggestions.

tools.name: dropslop_surgical_humanize
tools.description: Rewrite only the paragraphs of a document that read machine-made, leaving CLEAN paragraphs and Markdown structure as they are, and run Fact-Guard, which checks that no names, numbers, dates or quotations were added or changed. Read the rewrite before you use it.

tools.name: dropslop_humanize
tools.description: Rewrite a document or long article so it reads less machine-made, using DropSlop's multi-paragraph cadence planner ('strict', 'stealth', or 'dual' mode returning both drafts and stealth_diff). Read the rewrite before you use it.

tools.name: dropslop_reroll_paragraph
tools.description: Priority-0 single-paragraph surgical rewrite with surrounding sentence context, All-4-Gates ranking, and Fact-Guard.

tools.name: dropslop_site_audit
tools.description:
Crawl and audit a domain, sitemap, or URL list using DropSlop's high-speed Go crawler (fastcrawl) with automatic straggler cutoff, clean HTML

extraction, and batched AI detection.

tools.name: dropslop_certify
tools.description: Issue a tamper-evident certificate (/v/{cert_id}): a signed record of this exact text (SHA-256 hash), the scores it got from DropSlop's checker and, for a verified certificate, from two outside detectors, and a Fact-Guard receipt. A certificate is a record of a check, not proof of who wrote the text

tools.name: dropslop_critique_for_agent

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dropslop_site_audit, dropslop_certify, dropslop_voice_profile · Private data: dropslop_detect, dropslop_xray, dropslop_surgical_humanize, dropslop_humanize, dropslop_certify, dropslop_corpus_monoculture_check, dropslop_stylometric_authorship_verify, dropslop_diff_gate · Public sink: dropslop_corpus_monoculture_check, dropslop_diff_gate · Destructive: dropslop_xray, dropslop_surgical_humanize, dropslop_skim_and_dropoff_forensics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dropslop_site_audit, dropslop_certify, dropslop_voice_profile · Private data: dropslop_detect, dropslop_xray, dropslop_surgical_humanize, dropslop_humanize, dropslop_certify, dropslop_corpus_monoculture_check, dropslop_stylometric_authorship_verify, dropslop_diff_gate · Public sink: dropslop_corpus_monoculture_check, dropslop_diff_gate · Destructive: dropslop_xray, dropslop_surgical_humanize, dropslop_skim_and_dropoff_forensics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
